newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Six dead, 12 hurt as Azeri bus plunges off road.
newsitem.headline: Six dead, 12 hurt as Azeri bus plunges off road.

text.p: Six people died and 12 were injured when a bus plunged off a steep mountain road in northern Azerbaijan, Russian news agencies reported on Thursday.
The accident happened late on Wednesday near the village of Zeykhur, Interfax reported from the Azeri capital, Baku.
Azeri officials could not immediately be contacted.
